alt_texts: Close-up of a wild Bengal tiger resting among bushes in Ranthambore, headline 'Shave a tiger and it's still striped'
Wild Bengal tiger in Ranthambore standing over its prey, side-on to show its stripe pattern, with text explaining the stripes are on the skin too
Wild tiger walking on a riverbank sandbar with text explaining no two tigers have the same stripes
Wild tiger walking toward the camera through forest in Ranthambore with text on camera-trap identification
Tiger lying in a forest pool with the statistic of about 3,140 mature tigers left in the wild
The same wild Bengal tiger beside its prey in dry forest, with text on its Endangered IUCN status and decreasing trend
Closing slide over a tiger portrait listing scientific sources and photo credits
